name: gds-design-system
description: GOV.UK Design System depth for agents building user journeys. Every component, pattern and style from the Design System, with the full Nunjucks macro API, as offline reference files — so agents stop reading node_modules for template code and start following the guidance on how components are meant to be used. Includes GOV.UK Prototype Kit plumbing and end-to-end journey assembly. Skills and a guard hook, no agent.
